definition: Businesses primarily developing digital games; census headcount, not FTE. ABS cautions historical change estimates; retain as snapshots, separate from IGEA.
trend_review: Both are ABS headcounts at the last pay period ending June, but the archive describes changing scope/coverage and expressly cautions historical comparison. The country catalogue likewise records AU_abs_headcount as chart_eligible but trend_eligible false and prohibits joining it to IGEA. Isolated markers only; no connecting lines.
